senses.definition: mt. on border of Edom, always הֹר הָהָר, named as stage in Isr.’s journey to Canaan Nu 20:22; 21:4; 33:37 Dt 32:50; as place of Aaron’s death Nu 20:23, 25, 27; 33:38, 39, 41 Dt 32:50 (all P); = mod. Jebel Nebi Hârûn c. 50 miles S. of Dead Sea, just S. (SW.) of Petra, according to RobBR ii, 125, 152, cf. 519 ff. BdPal. 153; disputed by Ew Kn Di, & especially TrumbullKadesh Barnea 128 ff., who thinks of J. Madurah, NW. of Edom.
a NE. spur of Lebanon Nu 34:7, 8 (P); mod. Jebel ʿAkkar cf. PorterDamascus, ed. 2, p. 333 NbrGéogr. du Talm. p. 9 FurrerZPV viii. 27; yet v. Di.
